items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: Isaiah used to play with me

ctx.x: who do you remember the guys in his bands or you're too little for that

oh yeah I know a lot of the guys uh Jim Cora used to play with me and Isaiah used to play with me and I tried to play with him stuff stuff stuff stuff stuff I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. If I say my name, but you know, I forget the name. I don't know.
Did Howard ever play drums with him?
